title: People wear the cross as jewelry.
paragraphs: People wear the cross as jewelry.
But 2,000 years ago it was an execution device.

Jesus didn’t go there for symbolism.
He went there for rescue.

You weren’t just forgiven.
You were saved from something real.

The cross wasn’t meant to be decoration.
It was a rescue operation.
Jesus stepped into our mess, carried the weight of sin, and paid the price we couldn’t.
Most people see the cross as a religious symbol.
But the Bible presents it as a rescue operation for sinners.

Be honest:
Do you see the cross as symbolic… or saving? ✝️
